name: evidence-selfcheck-refresh-honesty
title: Reject self-contradictory evidence rows and stop refresh_stale from laundering unverified pass assertions
description: Two mechanical ways false verification evidence enters the ledger today, both fixable with no schema change: (1) verification_evidence_add accepts a row whose own command and file fields name contradictory targets; (2) verification_evidence_refresh_stale re-stamps freshness hashes onto a stale result:pass without ever re-executing, laundering an unverified assertion onto new material. This is the cheapest first slice of the evidence-integrity program.
